notes.title: Small update! QOL improvements, steeper difficulty curve, faster games
notes.notes:
Small update!!

Hi everyone 🙂 I re-visit this game every once in a while and I'm pushing an update to make some tiny changes to things that were bugging me! Should make the game more fun!


 Added more indicators on the minimap! The minimap now has additional indicators for obstacle cars, blockades, falling meteors, pizza-stealing pranksters, and for collectable pickups. Makes the car more useful!
 Updated the balancing! Games overall are harder and the difficulty ramp is much steeper. Games are more fun at the start and it takes less time to reach max rank!

Enjoy! 😃
